* '''Original''' ([[Harc Seff (V)]]): the slip prints power 2, ability 2, armor 3, deploy 2, forfeit 4, a pilot icon and a Set 0 icon. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Harc Seff (V) (Errata 2)]]): the PC image uploaded 31 July 2022 changes the printed mark from “E” to “E1”, removes the uniqueness dot from the bottom caption and increases the image dimensions from 350×490 to 745×1039 pixels.
